criteria.text: Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 28 September 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 28 September 2032 (72 months after Closing).

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (28 September 2027; 28 September 2032) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 1 July 2026 (454 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
